families.name: ceiling-tolerated single errors
families.reason: A wrong value read out of a multi-figure quote visibly moves exactly one scored item, and the 2% confident-wrong ceiling at these denominators honestly absorbs a single error — the gates tolerate it at the declared risk appetite. The operator kills 0 of its sites: it has no gate path at all at these denominators. #448 recorded the mechanism and #466 re-confirmed it at v13; the Wilson headroom constant behind it (upper 0.019 at n=296) is #448-era arithmetic on a smaller bed, not a current figure.

families.name: already-contained claims
families.reason: The mutated claim is already routed to review in the unmutated baseline — the windscreen unmodelled terms (#445) and the bare-excess referral answers (#461, #493) — so the mutant changes nothing observable: a survivor label on a mutant that never escaped anything.

notes: Declared against the census of 12 August 2026: mutation v1, scoring v14, 4527 mutants, 349 survivors, no remainder and no overlap. The v13 census (#466) was 261 in the same two families, 237 + 24: family 1 grew with #493's referral-shape fixtures, family 2 with the twelve review-routed referral answers the oracle now gives them (#484).

force_confidence_high has no sites in this recording, because the oracle answers all-high. That operator stays unexercised until the harness runs over real model recordings — a gap in coverage, not a clean sweep.
drop_obligation, invent_obligation, deadline_digit and invent_date have no sites either: this pack extracts terms, not obligations, so those operators are exercised on the letter pack's bed.
